claims.claim_text: Google 移除了 Chromium 裡最後幾個讓 Manifest V2 擴充還能運作的旗標，MV2 的淘汰正式收場。
claims.location: item-01「Chrome 拔掉最後的旗標，Manifest V2 正式收尾」
claims.evidence: Chromium 150 lost ExtensionManifestV2Disabled option ... Chromium 151 will loose ExtensionManifestV2Unsupported option ... 看起來 Manifest V2 (MV2) 要進入到末章了
claims.note: Source documents removal of the remaining MV2-enabling flags across Chromium 150/151 and frames it as MV2's final chapter.

claims.claim_text: 最受關注的衝擊落在廣告攔截器上——這波報導正是以「終結熱門 ad blocker」為題。
claims.location: item-01「Chrome 拔掉最後的旗標，Manifest V2 正式收尾」
claims.evidence: Google Chrome is killing all uBlock Origin bypasses, Microsoft Edge, Opera to follow
claims.note: 原稿斷言『主流廣告攔截器將隨之失效』為 MV2 移除的直接後果，但 gslin 來源本文未作此斷言，該效果只出現在所連結外部報導的標題。[FIX r1] 已改寫為只陳述『最受關注的衝擊落在廣告攔截器上，這波報導以終結熱門 ad blocker 為題』，把效果歸給報導框架而非斷言事實，去掉 hedge inflation。

claims.claim_text: 論文宣稱在 NVIDIA B200 上 GEMM 達 2 PFlop/s（cuBLAS 的 96%）。
claims.location: item-02「把 fearless concurrency 帶上 GPU——cuTile Rust」
claims.evidence: On the NVIDIA B200 GPU, cuTile Rust achieves 7 TB/s for element-wise operations and 2 PFlop/s for GEMM (96% of cuBLAS)
claims.note: Abstract states the exact figure; lede attributes it as a paper claim, matching source strength.

claims.claim_text: IETF 把 QUERY 方法定為標準（RFC 10008）：它讓客戶端把查詢條件放進 request body、而不是塞進 URI。QUERY 同時是 safe 與 idempotent、回應可被快取。
claims.location: item-03「HTTP 終於有了 QUERY——帶 body 的安全查詢成標準」
claims.evidence: the input to the query operation is passed as the content of the request rather than as part of the request URI ... QUERY requests are safe with regard to the target resource ... QUERY requests are idempotent ... The response to a QUERY method is cacheable
claims.note: Source confirms body-not-URI input and safe+idempotent+cacheable verbatim. The RFC header reads 'Internet Standards Track document'; Proposed Standard is the first Standards-Track maturity rung, so the standardization status is confirmed. Core claim verified.

claims.claim_text: 惡意碼放在 app/test/index.js、偽裝成註解掉的測試，靠 package.json 的 prepare lifecycle script 在安裝相依套件時自動執行，再從攻擊者控制的網域抓 payload。
claims.location: item-04「藏在 npm install 裡的後門——一封 LinkedIn 職缺邀約」
claims.evidence: The trap was in app/test/index.js, about 250 lines disguised as a test suite ... The prepare script is the important one. npm runs prepare automatically after npm install, so just installing dependencies executes the backdoor.
claims.note: Location, disguise, prepare auto-run on npm install, and remote payload fetch all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 作者自己說，在更累或更趕的一天，他很可能會先跑 npm install 才想清楚。
claims.location: item-04「藏在 npm install 裡的後門——一封 LinkedIn 職缺邀約」
claims.evidence: on a more tired or rushed day, I could easily have run npm install before thinking it through.
claims.note: Direct paraphrase of the author's self-reflection; matches verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 論文宣稱 KVCache eviction 最多降 2 到 2.6 倍、整體 session 完成時間最多快 3.5 倍。
claims.location: item-05「Coding agent 把 KVCache 壓垮了——CacheWise 怎麼接住」
claims.evidence: CacheWise reduces KVCache evictions by up to 2-2.6x and improves total agent session completion time by up to 3.5x.
claims.note: Abstract numbers match exactly; lede uses 宣稱/up-to framing matching source.

claims.claim_text: 論文宣稱訓練吞吐量比現有的 Metis、Sailor 等異質平行化器最多高 2.3 倍。
claims.location: item-06「Tangram：把 GPU 的異質性藏起來，讓舊平行化器照用」
claims.evidence: Tangram achieves up to 2.3x higher training throughput than current heterogeneous parallelizers (Metis and Sailor).
claims.note: Abstract states 2.3x with named baselines Metis and Sailor verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 在自己的機器上跑 LLM，工具鏈已經成熟到實用；文章從硬體一路講到推論引擎，重點是整個本地端的體驗終於順了。對在評估本地推論的人，這是一份務實的現況回顧。
claims.location: item-07「現在在自己機器上跑 LLM，真的可以了」
claims.note: 核心命題（本地 LLM 因工具鏈成熟而變得實用）有來源支持。原稿另加『對在意資料不出門、或想擺脫 API 帳單的人』這組來源未提的讀者動機，且把『量化』列入主要脈絡而來源著墨甚少。[FIX r1] 已刪去隱私/API 帳單動機子句、改為『對在評估本地推論的人』，並把列舉改為『從硬體一路講到推論引擎』，移除來源未支持的成分。

claims.claim_text: obliv-clang 是一個編譯期檢查工具，能驗證 C++ 程式是否 oblivious；它特別處理 C++ 裡棘手的任意巢狀指標，並對所訂規則做了形式化的健全性證明，論文宣稱編出來的程式能勝過先前的方案。
claims.location: item-08「obliv-clang——在編譯期就檢查 C++ 程式抗不抗側通道」
claims.evidence: a compilation-time checking tool, obliv-clang, which can comprehensively check the obliviousness of a program written in C++ ... arbitrarily nested pointers ... formally prove their soundness ... programs compiled using obliv-clang can outperform previous solutions
claims.note: Abstract confirms all four elements; 宣稱 framing matches source.

claims.claim_text: 官方數字是：相較 Graviton4，算力最多提升 25%、L3 快取大五倍、記憶體頻寬也增強。
claims.location: item-09「AWS Graviton5 出了——往更大的快取與頻寬靠」
claims.evidence: Graviton5 offers up to 25% better compute performance compared to Graviton4-based instances ... 5 times more L3 cache compared to the previous generation ... up to 15% higher network bandwidth
claims.note: Source confirms up to 25% compute, 5x L3 cache, and increased bandwidth vs Graviton4. URL resolved (no 404).

claims.claim_text: 作者的 Marvell 晶片 10GBASE-T SFP+ 模組（MikroTik S+RJ10）正常情況下飆到 93°C，超過約 95°C 就 flapping；換成 Broadcom 晶片的 10Gtek ASF-10G-T80-INT 後，交換器 CPU 溫度降約 5°C，連續兩週沒再斷線。
claims.location: item-10「10G SFP+ 模組過熱 flapping，換 Broadcom 晶片解掉」
claims.evidence: the one in nigel, the study switch, was a worrying 93C ... about 95C, I think ... the MikroTik S+RJ10 ... was indeed a Marvell one ... a 10Gtek ASF-10G-T80-INT ... it has been running about 5C cooler since
claims.note: 93°C normal, ~95°C threshold, MikroTik S+RJ10 (Marvell), 10Gtek ASF-10G-T80-INT (Broadcom), ~5°C cooler all confirmed; switch on 1 June with sustained stable operation consistent with the ~two-week window.
